steps.executor_prompt: Minimize this app, then go to the Gmail app. Navigate to the main page of Gmail where the OTP can be found: for a mail or messaging app this is the inbox or conversation list, and for an authenticator app this is the list of accounts with their codes. Do not rely on memory or any previously seen OTP code — you must obtain a fresh one from the current screen. If it is the detailed page of a message, go back to the main inbox. If the app shows a list of messages or emails, refresh it (e.g. swipe down from the top), wait 3 seconds for it to load, check the Default Browser and go to marriott.com, then open the newest item at the top and read the OTP code inside it. If the app directly displays rotating codes, find the entry corresponding to Default Browser and go to marriott.com and read its currently displayed code; if that code is about to expire, wait for it to rotate and read the new one. Report that OTP code as your final answer.

Return to Default Browser and go to marriott.com and verify that the visible page belongs to the exact target, the intended account is {user}, and the pending challenge is the one that produced {otp_code}. If needed to restore that flow, enter {password} only when required. Clear the OTP field, enter {otp_code} without spaces, submit once, wait, and re-observe. Report success only when the exact target visibly shows an account name or avatar, account-specific controls or dashboard, a sign-out control, or an explicit login-success confirmation; a public landing page, sign-in control, or authenticated state in Gmail is not success. Request one replacement only if the exact target explicitly says the code is incorrect or expired while still signed out. If requested, open Gmail, confirm the switch, refresh if applicable, and read only a demonstrably new code for the exact target and intended account. Return to Default Browser and go to marriott.com, confirm the same challenge, submit the new code once, and verify target authentication. If no new code arrives or authentication is not proven, return to Default Browser and go to marriott.com, leave the exact target visible, and report failure.
